title: The Hedge Witch
text: A witch in a hut on chicken legs, the legs folded under it like a roosting hen's, smoke curling from the chimney. She leans out of the window, all nose and knuckles. She has a cure for what ails you. Her price is always the same: a lock of hair, freely given.

options.label: The most hurt takes her cure.

outcomes.text: It works, and she strokes the lock of hair as if it were gold, and puts it somewhere safe.
A good potion, foul-tasting and strong.

options.label: Leave before the hut stands up.

outcomes.text: It stands up anyway, and watches you go, and the witch throws a pinch of something after you that sets every eye streaming.
